- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_pr_reconcile.sh:205-253 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A rejected push is treated as a transient skip, leaving the heal PR alive with its superseded head.
  WHY: The script skips rather than closing or updating the stranded heal PR; all reviewers who reported severity rated this high.
- .github/workflows/internal-cancel-on-pr-close.yml:19-53 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The reconcile job checks out the repository before its script-level skip logic and declares only contents: read despite using GH_PAT for git pushes and GitHub API writes.
  WHY: The checkout still occurs when the kill switch is false, and the declared permissions may not support the writes; severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated this BLOCKER, while the others rated it MAJOR.
- agents.md:~130 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE log prefix is absent from the contractual stable log prefixes list.
  WHY: Workflow-log-analysis pipelines will not recognize reconcile events; both reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:52 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The allowlist description says the script rebases heal PRs, but the script uses git merge and fast-forward push, never rebasing.
  WHY: This newly added description is misleading to maintainers auditing the integration-ref allowlist.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_pr_reconcile.sh:195-214 | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A concurrent push after the remote-head pre-check can be overwritten by the script's later push.
  WHY: The script does not re-check the heal branch immediately before pushing, so a concurrent fast-forward update may be lost.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_pr_reconcile.sh:64-69 | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A misconfigured WORKFLOW_HEAL_LABEL can silently make every reconcile run no-op without signaling the label-filter error.
  WHY: The script does not validate that the configured label matches the issue labels it is meant to find.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_pr_reconcile.sh:211-214 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The script can log “retargeted” without explicitly updating the heal PR base when GitHub has not auto-retargeted it.
  WHY: The heal PR may remain pointed at the old base, leaving its diff incorrect.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Log lines are prefixed `WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE` (`closed … reason=…`, `retargeted …`, `skip reason=…`)" (PR description, README "Workflow Failure Heal" section, agents.md prose update at lines 122-142)
  Expected change site: `agents.md` "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" section — the `LOG_PREFIX.name=WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE` line, alongside the existing `LOG_PREFIX.name=WORKFLOW_HEAL_AUTOFIX_REPORT` and `LOG_PREFIX.name=WORKFLOW_HEAL` entries.
  Evidence of absence: `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_pr_reconcile.sh:38` emits `echo "WORKFLOW_HEAL_PR_RECONCILE $*"` and uses that prefix across `closed …`, `retargeted …`, `warn …`, and `skip reason=…` log lines. The `agents.md` diff at lines 122-142 updates only the prose paragraph describing the pipeline summary, not the contractual prefix table. `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py` (`tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:187` per the existing plan doc) asserts the `LOG_PREFIX.name=` pattern; without an entry, the workflow-log-analysis pipeline will not surface reconcile events in optimization reports. Every previous addition of a new stable log prefix (e.g. `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET`, `STAGED_SUPPORT_LATCH_RELEASED`, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_AUTOFIX_REPORT`) has been paired with both a bullet entry and a `LOG_PREFIX.name=` entry; this PR adds the prose mention but omits the registry entry.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
